Package com.bupt.ta.servlet

Class CvDownloadServlet

java.lang.Object
javax.servlet.GenericServlet
javax.servlet.http.HttpServlet
com.bupt.ta.servlet.BaseServlet
com.bupt.ta.servlet.CvDownloadServlet
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, javax.servlet.Servlet, javax.servlet.ServletConfig
public class CvDownloadServlet extends BaseServlet
Streams an applicant's CV file to the browser.

URL pattern: /cv (mapped in web.xml)

Role access:

  • Authenticated TA — downloads own CV (or pending session CV)
  • Authenticated MO with userId parameter — downloads that applicant's CV
Unauthenticated callers are redirected to /login; unauthorized MO access returns 403.

Only GET is supported. Files are served inline with detected content type.
